artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: A new TMP_FIXTURE origin class ('tmp-fixture') is assigned to a pytest tmp_path/tmpdir/tmp_path_factory parameter (or the bare free name, when not shadowed) instead of the generic UNKNOWN a normal caller-supplied parameter gets; _join now dominates a joined UNKNOWN with TMP_FIXTURE the same way it dominates one with LIBRARY, so a def-use-walked path rooted in a measured fixture (e.g. `folder = tmp_path / name` where `name` is an unresolved loop variable) still resolves to ['tmp-fixture'] rather than degrading to ['unknown']. census_source's reach formula drops the blanket `not is_test` gate that erased EVERY unknown in a test file by default and replaces it with an explicit exemption for `origins == {TMP_FIXTURE}` only, so a genuinely-unresolved origin in a test file is now counted exactly like one in a non-test file (LIBRARY still dominates everything, unchanged). Each row now also carries `is_test`. code_census() adds test_sites/tmp_fixture_sites/test_unknown_sites counters over that field. main()'s --code-census arm gains a second positive control (a LIBRARY-origin plant inside a temp tests/ directory, proving the exempting branch's own LIBRARY-precedes-exemption path is exercised, not merely read) and, under a new --plant-unknown-in-test flag, a difference control (an opaque-origin write planted in a test module) that must flip test_unknown_sites from 0 to 1; without the flag the census is unchanged. All totals print both before and after the per-site lines.

6 new tests added beside the 91 pre-existing: a LIBRARY-origin write in a file named test_plant_control.py is flagged (mirrors the CLI's new positive_control_test_file plant); a tmp_path/tmpdir/tmp_path_factory PARAMETER write resolves to origins == ['tmp-fixture'] and is not counted, parametrized over all three fixture names (3 cases); a tmp_path-rooted path joined with an unresolved for-loop variable (the real corpus's own `folder = tmp_path / name` shape) stays fixture-rooted rather than degrading to unknown; a write whose origin resolves through a bare, unrecognized call (`open(compute(), "w")`) inside a test module is COUNTED (reaches_library True, origins == ['unknown']). 97 of 97 tests pass.
